AttributeList.Text: The Reset block sets the reader to a operational state. The Reset also acknowledges error conditions of the reader and resets a reader from a falty state to a OK-state.
The Read block sends a read command to the reader and delivers the read result for further processing.
The Write block sends a write command to the reader containing the data to be written to a transponder.
The Inventory block sends an inventory command to the reader and delivers the result for further processing
